# Synthetic recall set

*Generated by `scripts/gen_bench_pages.py` from the `oml-bench/1` results in `eval/bench/results/`; do not edit by hand. Regenerate with `python scripts/gen_bench_pages.py`, and CI fails when this page differs from what it writes.*

Suite `recall-synthetic`, data `eval/recall data version 1`: 200 memories, 121 queries; a method marked sampled asked a seeded subset, named in its row. Measured 2026-11-04 on commit `9a6a0d0`; build release, host 8 vCPU / 15 GB, postgres 17.9.

[All suites](index.md)

## Limits of this run

- One model wrote corpus, queries and labels; success counts grade 2, nDCG gains 2^g-1, k 10 under a 2,000-token budget, so recall@100 is not measured.

Sources: `eval/bench/results/recall-synthetic/keyword-all.json`, `eval/bench/results/recall-synthetic/keyword-any.json`, `eval/bench/results/recall-synthetic/bm25.json`, `eval/bench/results/recall-synthetic/bm25-trigram.json`.
